blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Classes at Far Eastern University (FEU) Manila were suspended late Wednesday, Sept. 23, as a precautionary measure following a reported bomb threat. In an advisory released at 8:20 p.m., the university’s Manila campus announced the suspension after reportedly receiving a bomb threat. “Students, faculty, employees, and support staff are advised to evacuate the campus calmly and in an orderly manner and follow the instructions of security personnel,” it said in the advisory.
